What it does: Nothing. The reaction is kept for later
Move up to 2 inches before the roll; this may reach cover
Go prone before the roll: the shooter has -1 die
The price: The reaction is used. Standing up costs an action (then a half Move), and a prone fighter is easier to hit in melee

What it does: Needs a ranged weapon, range and line of sight. The shot becomes an **opposed** roll: shooter's Shoot against target's Shoot, every source counted, dice cancelling as usual. The winner by any margin hits the loser at that margin's severity
The price: Both fighters can be hurt. A tie: each hits the other with a **glance**. Saves apply to whoever is hit
